_comment: Shared case table for the tool-call title derivation. Read by website/src/utils/toolCallTitle.test.ts and test/test_tool_call_title.py so the TypeScript and Python implementations cannot disagree. `title` is the English rendering; `action` null means the incoming title is kept (or, for shell, the raw command is shown). Regenerate with the generator in the PR description, or edit by hand.

cases.name: cat single file (src skipped in display name)
sed with tilde path is not literal
cd then relative read resolves against cwd
cat with two operands stays raw
python -c with a walker marker and a delete stays raw
ls with stderr silenced and head dropped
leading echo dropped in a chain
find piped to xargs rm falls back to the raw command
cat piped to xargs rm is not a read
xargs to an unknown binary is not a formatting tail
cat piped to xargs grep stays a read
plain sort is a formatting tail
rg with no pattern stays raw
read piped to grep = read and 1 more
any unknown segment falls back to raw
